copy.headline: Fort Worth recommends experienced developer for convention center hotel project
copy.caption:
The plans call for a 600- to 800-room, four-star or higher hotel. Downtown could soon see another major hotel as city staff have recommended Matthews Hospitality to develop a site just east of the Fort Worth Convention Center.

The recommendation will go before the city council in the first quarter next year. The hotel, on 4.6 acres, is targeted to open in the fourth quarter of 2029 or early 2030, along with a refurbished and expanded Fort Worth Convention Center.

story.title: Fort Worth recommends experienced developer for convention center hotel project
story.summary: The plans call for a 600- to 800-room, four-star or higher hotel. Downtown could soon see another major hotel as city staff have recommended Matthews Hospitality to develop a site just east of the Fort Worth Convention Center. The recommendation will go before the city council in the first quarter next year. The hotel, on 4.6 acres, is targeted to open in the fourth quarter of 2029 or early 2030, along with a refurbished and expanded Fort Worth Convention Center. The convention center is in the second phase of a massive $701 million makeover that will nearly double its capacity. A new convention center hotel has been seen as key to the success of the expanded center. According to the request for proposal the city released in April, the hotel project must include a 600- to 800-room hotel and be rated four-star or higher.
